negative_reviews.author: Under.Concrete
negative_reviews.text:
Staff were very friendly and helpful, clearly putting a lot of effort in and it made us feel very welcome. Ground floor seating was a bit uncomfortable, quite a few tables close together so somewhat noisy and you feel a bit like you're in a corridor especially if your back is facing the area people are walking through. We got the lunch deal which was very reasonably priced and promised to arrive in under thirty minutes (good if you're in a rush). It did arrive quite promptly.
For the speed and price I think you get what you'd expect for the food. It's about average in most places though the vegan chicken used in the Vegan Chicken Katsu was notably a bit cardboardy.
Come for quick, reliable, and reasonably priced food but don't expect it to rival the quality of food from independent Japanese restaurants in the area.
